title: CORRSTEER: GENERATION-TIME LLM STEERING VIA CORRELATED SPARSE AUTOENCODER FEATURES
findings: The CorrSteer method was effective in steering model behavior for the 'Religion' category in a text classification task. It surpassed the non-steered model by improving fairness scores in bias mitigation experiments and generally increased bias scores in bias amplification experiments.
